in_marathi.name: Preyash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Preyash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Preyash means 'bringing happiness to others' or 'one who brings joy'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'preet' which means love and 'ash' which means joy. The name is a combination of these two meanings.
